name: Container and Packaging
old_description: It’s what’s inside that matters. This is the outside (which also matters). Start with the right material (glass, plastic, recycled, or metal), then dial in size, color, and finish. Closures are here too, if you’re ready for us to put a lid on it.
about:
Container and Packaging operates from Boise, Idaho, as a wholesale supplier of bottles, jars, and packaging supplies. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders.

The company stocks containers in glass, plastic (PET, HDPE, PP), metal, and post-consumer resin (PCR), and offers closures such as pumps, sprayers, and droppers. Beyond distribution, it provides in-house decoration services including screen printing, hot foil stamping, and shrink sleeves, as well as custom boxes, packaging design, label printing, warehousing, logistics, and sourcing through a worldwide network of manufacturing partners. Customers range from small businesses ordering a few hundred units to larger brands requiring pallet quantities.

Container and Packaging serves industries including food storage, chemical and industrial, pharmaceutical, essential oils, art supply, pet care, nutrition and supplement, food and beverage, and personal care. Customer stories highlight brands such as Lone Star Bee Co. (honey), Amallow Skincare & Beauty (tallow creams), and Brwnsgr Skincare (sensitive-skin products), illustrating a focus on small-to-mid-sized consumer-goods companies.

The company emphasizes human-driven service: dedicated account representatives proactively manage accounts, offer multiple shipping options, provide samples, and resolve issues quickly. Its website encourages customers to call for personalized sourcing help rather than relying solely on search, positioning accessible expertise as a key differentiator.
